text_block_list.text: One day, while walking around the school—
(Ding dong dang dong Ding dong daaang!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Next!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Number 7, Kitasan Black! Shouldering 
both smiles and farewells, I will sing. 
The song is—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Huh, were there still participants left 
for the audition?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Oh well. It makes no difference whether 
the singing samples for empathetic 
understanding are from an Umamusume or a 
human, as long as there are plenty of 
them."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Then sing after her! Let us hear your 
voice as well!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Cut the chatter and get in line behind us. 
It's her turn first. Come on, go ahead.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'm looking forward to working with 
you!

And so, I got dragged into a mysterious 
singing audition...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Entry number 18! Take the stage and sing!

I've finally been dragged in front of the 
mic. Now that it's come to this, I just 
have to brace myself—
choice_data_list:
Burn with fierce passion! Sing with all 
your heart!

text_block_list.text:
I decided to sing while recalling a 
lullaby I heard a long time ago.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Whoa, whoa... of all things, a lullaby...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh my~ What a nostalgic song~. I wonder 
who is singing it~?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
*Yaaawn*... What a gentle song~. I think 
I'll take an afternoon nap too~...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

Bathed in the warm sunshine, the singing 
audition came to an end.

"...Today might also prove useful for 
helping <chrname> relax."

Shaking her head, generating her own 
groove...! She shouted from the bottom of 
her heart...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ngh! I can feel such burning passion from 
this!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... 'Passion,' is it? What kind of 
sensation is that?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hearing these cheers makes my very soul 
burn hotter and hotter...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Haaaan!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Mmm~~gh, excellent! Bravooo~~!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...There are more...

Before I knew it, a large number of 
Umamusume had gathered on the stage.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Everyone, let's get hyped up!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Woo-hoo! Wonderfoool Singers!! Paassion! 
Paassion!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Could this also be a type of resonance 
phenomenon? No..."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Paaassion! Paaassion!! Paaassion! 
Paaassion!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, that's not right. What even is 
this?"

I feel like I learned what passion really 
is. I should share this with <chrname> next time.
